hypothesis: Executing only supplied public examples provides useful revision feedback beyond a neutral second review.
second_call_generation_max: min(2048, remaining completion after first generation and feedback cost, remaining context); no dispatch if nonpositive
first_call_messages: identical across arms for each frozen task/seed; fresh independent identities, counterbalanced arm order
first_reply_invalid_json_or_schema: terminal format failure in both arms; no replacement or redraw
first_reply_valid_action_but_rejected_co: allow one assigned revision with public candidate_rejected feedback in public_check; record initial rejection separately
second_turn_control: neutral review message, no computed test results
second_turn_variant: only public_check.feedback over examples visible in original reset; no task hidden-case access
final_grade: unchanged frozen native verifier, including failures in full assigned denominator
analysis: paired arm effect and task/case breakdown; initial errors, final format/provider/execution/budget failures separate from valid wrong/partial/full; no selection or pooling with earlier screen
confirmation: fresh disjoint seeds, resets, workspace hashes and independent complete call identities; no promotion from screen alone
known_limit: two-step proxy revision differs from the frozen one-response Arena candidate; no claim of production equivalence or training readiness
